title: Young Woman in 1940s Fashion, 1940s Snapshot, Black & White, USA
description: A full-length black and white snapshot from the mid-1940s capturing a young woman posing in a grassy yard backed by lush trees. She is dressed in typical 1940s attire, featuring a two-piece light-colored suit with a short-sleeved peplum blouse, a knee-length skirt, a patterned headscarf or hair wrap, and white cut-out peep-toe shoes with dark nail polish showing. The image features classic deckle-edged borders, characteristic of mid-century consumer photo finishing.
